title: The Voice of the Nation (Ka Sur Ka Jaidbynriew)
cultural_context: Stirring call for unity across all Khasi sub-tribes (Khynriam, Pnar, Bhoi, War, Maram) into one cohesive cultural brotherhood, from 'Ki Sur Ka Mynnor Bad Mynta'.

khasi: Sngap ia ka sur jong ka jaidbynriew,
Ba sawa na Kupli haduh Titos;
U Khynriam, u Pnar, u Bhoi bad u War,
U Maram ba shlur ha ki them bad ki lum;
Kawei ka snam, kawei ka nia,
Ba pyniatylli ia ngi ha ka hok.
english: Hark to the united voice of the nation,
Echoing from Kopili river unto the Titos;
The Khynriam of the plateau, Pnar of Jaintia, Bhoi of the plains, War of the cliffs,
And valiant Maram of the western ranges;
We share one common father and one mother,
All children of the Seven Huts together;
One sacred blood, one righteous cause,
Uniting us in justice and truth.

khasi: To phet noh ka jingpait jingpra,
Ka jingiapher ktien kam dei ban pynduh;
Ha ka dohnud ka shong kawei ka sur,
Ba kwah ia ka jingsuk jong ka ri;
Ieng, ko ki khun ka Bri U Hynniewtrep,
Ngin rwai ka sur jong ka jingkyrmen,
Jong ka pateng ba dang wan.
english: Let division and factional discord flee away,
Differences in dialect must never sever our bond;
In every breast beats one identical chord,
Yearning for the enduring peace of our motherland;
Arise, children of the Sacred Realm of Seven Huts,
Let us raise together the anthem of high hope,
Of generations yet to be born.

vocabulary.bri u hynniewtrep: the sacred domain/realm of the Seven Huts
